questions.description: Unanswered human intent or decisions, not code research tasks. Must be empty with proceed.

concerns.description: Advisory risks and planning or review considerations; may be nonempty with proceed. Use clarify for unanswered human questions and escalate for decisions requiring human authority.

conflicts.description: Actual incompatibilities between the requested outcome and the charter; identify the rule and why the request violates it. Hypothetical implementation hazards belong in concerns. Must be empty with proceed.
